title: CF Registry Extract Row
description: Frozen standardized record schema for epidemiological indicators extracted from national and continental Cystic Fibrosis patient registry annual data reports.

row_id.description: Unique deterministic identifier for this extraction row (e.g. ECFSPR-2022-P08-R01).

report_title.description: Official title of the registry annual data report publication.

report_year.description: Reporting data year of the registry cohort.

page_number.description: 1-indexed page number as printed in the official report PDF.

table_id.description: Table or section identifier in the report (e.g. Table 1.1 or Summary of data report).

indicator_id.description: Normalized snake_case identifier for the clinical/demographic indicator.

indicator_name.description: Human-readable indicator label as stated in the table row header.

stratum_sex.description: Biological sex stratification of the indicator cohort.

count_n.description: Observed count of patients (n), if applicable.

percentage.description: Observed percentage of the cohort (0.0 to 100.0), if applicable.

denominator_n.description: Cohort denominator for percentage calculations, if reported or footnoted.

value_point.description: Point estimate (mean, rate, score) when neither count nor median applies.

value_low.description: Lower bound of the observed interval (25th percentile, 95% CI lower, or minimum).

value_high.description: Upper bound of the observed interval (75th percentile, 95% CI upper, or maximum).

unit.description: Physical, statistical, or demographic unit of measurement.

source_sha256.description: Cryptographic SHA-256 digest of the source PDF document in sources/downloads/.

raw_text_quote.description: Verbatim text extracted from the source table cell or row.

extraction_kind.description: Epistemic kind per cf-research-context: observed (verbatim), computed (formula), or inferred.

notes.description: Associated report footnotes, sample restrictions, or methodology clarifications.
